name: HuggingChat
summary: Hugging Face's chat app for open-source models, with automatic model routing.
description: HuggingChat is Hugging Face's chat application built on open-source models. Its Omni mode routes each request to a suitable model automatically, and users can also pick a specific model from the catalogue of more than one hundred available models. Conversations can use tools such as web search. Basic use is free with a Hugging Face account; the Hugging Face PRO subscription at $9 per month adds higher usage limits and inference credits.

howToUse.title: Open HuggingChat
howToUse.description: Open HuggingChat and choose Start chatting. With a Hugging Face account, basic use costs nothing.

howToUse.title: Let Omni pick the model, or choose one
howToUse.description: Leave Omni on so it routes each request to a suitable model automatically, or pick a specific model from the catalogue. The page lists 133 models, and the catalogue has more than one hundred.

howToUse.title: Use web search in the conversation
howToUse.description: In the conversation, use tools such as web search when the reply needs information beyond the model.

howToUse.title: Raise limits with PRO
howToUse.description: For higher usage limits and inference credits, take the Hugging Face PRO subscription at $9 per month.
